relations.text: Ardagh Metal Packagingが20-Fで、主要顧客の一社に挙げる(製品の8割超が缶入り)
relations.text_en: Ardagh Metal Packaging lists it among its major customers (over 80% of its drinks are sold in cans)

source.label: Ardagh Metal Packaging 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Some of our major customers include AB InBev, Carlsberg (including the recently acquired Britvic), Celsius Holdings (which recently acquired Alani Nu and Rockstar Energy), Cidade Imperial, Coca-Cola, Heineken, Keuring Dr. Pepper, Mark Anthony Brands, Molson Coors, Monster Beverage, National Beverage Company and PepsiCo, among others.

relations.text: 会長兼CEOが保有する会社と経営契約を結び、年1,180万ドルの手数料を払う(2026年5月期)
relations.text_en: Management agreement with a company owned by its Chairman and CEO; $11.8 million in fees (FY2026)

source.label: National Beverage 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: Pursuant to a management agreement, we incurred fees to Corporate Management Advisors, Inc. ("CMA") of $11.8 million and $12.0 million for Fiscal 2026 and Fiscal 2025, respectively.

relations.text: 10-Kで、業界を支配する大手の競合として名指し
